Generally it’s been positive, however putting personal opinion of personalities and NHS / surgery red tape , I have now had TWO referrals missed / lost / not done, which to me is shocking and disgusting and pretty much sums up the demise of the NHS.
Firstly for myself, I had a referral for a (fortunately benign) lump to be removed in 2023 and only when chasing late 2024 (extended time due to pregnancy in between), I found out it hadn’t actually been actioned by Willow Green and the lump is now 2x the size and I’ve had to go through all appt & scans etc again and still on a waiting list.

And now most recently for my 10 month old baby, who has intolerances and was supposedly referred to a paediatric dietician at Worthing Hospital following an appt in February at Willow Green, I have found it it was never actioned!!
A baby! Who has intolerances and is on a time frame for testing / next steps - disgusting!!

So emails, calls, double scans, double appts, double blood tests because of incompetence / administrative laziness is what is bringing the NHS down, not the general public and larger populations etc.

Anyway, if you’ve got this far, I hope this gives some insight to the surgery’s background and why I will be raising a formal complaint & switching surgeries (although I’m sure they’re all the same these days) but hey- strike cos you deserve more pay,
